What calls what Items

Randomised robustness testing for the RIFF chunk walker.

clean_wav_bytes exists because lofty cannot remove ID3v2 from a WAV, so VeilVoice walks the chunk list itself. That means it parses a container somebody else produced, with every length field under their control — the textbook setting for an overrun or a loop that never ends.

The properties asserted, for any input at all:

1. It returns. No panic, and no unbounded loop: every iteration must advance pos, whatever the chunk sizes claim. 2. A success is a valid WAV. If it hands back bytes, those bytes must parse as RIFF/WAVE with a length field that matches what was written — it is not permitted to emit something the next tool chokes on. 3. It never invents audio. Output length is bounded by input length.

Set VEILVOICE_FUZZ_ROUNDS to run it longer than the default.
